claim: A user-manager dbus.service can be active (running) as part of user@1000.service while DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS is still EMPTY in the user's shell — service activation and environment-variable propagation are separate mechanisms, requiring systemd to import the address into the user-manager environment (systemctl --user set-environment / dbus.socket ExecStartPost)
stance_target: an agent cannot assume the session bus is reachable just because dbus.service is running; it must check the env var and socket path
evidence_type: anecdotal (forum thread with verbatim systemctl output)
quoted_support: a user-manager dbus.service can be ACTIVE (running) as user@1000.service/dbus.service with dbus-daemon --session --address=systemd: while the environment variable DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS is still EMPTY in the shell — service activation and env-var propagation are separate mechanisms

claim: An ABSTRACT socket address like unix:abstract=/tmp/dbus-... indicates a stray per-session bus created by dbus-launch that is NOT the systemd user bus; the fix is to remove the dbus-launch invocation from shell/xinitrc startup files
stance_target: diagnosing wrong-bus connections: abstract sockets = dbus-launch bus, not the user bus
quoted_support: an ABSTRACT socket address like unix:abstract=/tmp/dbus-... comes from dbus-launch and indicates a stray per-session bus that is NOT the systemd user bus; fix is to remove the dbus-launch invocation from shell/xinitrc startup files

claim: Stale user unit overrides under /etc/systemd/user/dbus.service or ~/.config/systemd/user shadow the correct /usr/lib/systemd/user/dbus.service and keep DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS unset even after removing them requires checking both locations
stance_target: unit-override shadowing as a root cause of session-bus env-var absence
scope_conditions: systemd hosts with hand-modified unit files
quoted_support: Stale user unit overrides found under /etc/systemd/user/dbus.service or ~/.config/systemd/user shadow the correct /usr/lib/systemd/user/dbus.service and keep the address unset.

claim: The correct session-bus address value on systemd hosts is DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS=unix:path=/run/user/1000/bus, and the recommended diagnostic sequence is: systemctl status --user dbus.service, check XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/1000, and log in via a plain TTY instead of lightdm/DM to isolate the fault
stance_target: a concrete validation recipe for the session-bus dependency of a fleet agent
evidence_type: anecdotal (forum fellows' guidance, corroborated by Chimera docs)
quoted_support: Correct value on systemd hosts: DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS=unix:path=/run/user/1000/bus. Diagnostic sequence recommended: check systemctl status --user dbus.service, check XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/1000, log in via plain TTY instead of lightdm to isolate.
